title: VipPolicyEvaluateResult
description: vip.policy-evaluate-result@1: the answer of vip.resource.policy.evaluate on OpenVibe.VIP. POST /api/v1/policies/evaluate → { allow, reason, rule?, entitlement?, fallback? }. It fails closed: no owner, no rule, a disabled rule, a suspended creator, an entitlement VIP cannot confirm, a missing plan or perk, or any error is allow false with the reason. allow true only for the owner themselves (reason owner) or a member meeting the rule (member). fallback true when the product's default gate decided (rule null).
